generationProfile.scope: Measured nonstream ICL execution profile; not universal model capacity or voice quality

filterSemantics.greedy: Temperature zero bypasses top-k and nucleus sampling.
filterSemantics.topK: Zero or at least the codebook vocabulary disables top-k independently for that codebook.
filterSemantics.topP: Zero or one disables nucleus sampling. If filtering would erase all valid candidates, the registered runtime preserves the first maximum-logit candidate; already-valid filtered results are unchanged.
filterSemantics.repetition: The effective floor applies only to first-codebook recent history (64 positions); residual codebooks receive no generated history.
